integrity: The proof reconstructs all branch projectors and Fourier coefficients. Finite exact and floating-point checks corroborate but do not replace the infinite proof. No independent validation or independent audit has been performed.
object: The unweighted sunlet graph C_n corona K_1 with an adjacency-Hamiltonian continuous-time quantum walk; integer n at least 3.
principal_finding: The long-time average-mixing rank is 2n for n odd, n for n congruent to 2 mod 4, and n-1 for n divisible by 4, with the full Fourier-indexed spectrum supplied in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary adjacency-Hamiltonian Cesàro average only; one uniformly coupled pendant per cycle vertex; no assertion for general coronas, other Hamiltonians or weighted decorations; mathematical-literature coverage is not independently certified.
title: Spectral splitting and a modulo-four rank transition in quantum mixing on sunlet graphs
